001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005import pkg_entities.Item;
006
007/**
008 * Implements the {@code drop} command, moving an item from the inventory to the current room.
009 *
010 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
011 * @version 2026.05.08
012 */
013public class DropCommand extends Command {
014    /** Creates the command. */
015    public DropCommand() {}
016
017    /**
018     * Drops the named item and refunds its value to the player.
019     *
020     * @param pGameEngine the game engine containing the player inventory
021     * @return always {@code false}; this command does not end the game
022     */
023    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
024        if (!this.hasSecondWord()) {
025            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Drop what?");
026            return false;
027    }
028        String vItemName = this.getSecondWord();
029        Item vItem = pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem(vItemName);
030        if (vItem == null) {
031            pGameEngine.getGui().println("I can't find any " + vItemName + "!");
032            return false;
033        }
034        pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().addItem(vItemName, vItem);
035        pGameEngine.getPlayer().removeItem(vItemName);
036        pGameEngine.getGui().println("Dropped " + vItemName + "!");
037        pGameEngine.getPlayer().setMoney(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getMoney() + vItem.getItemPrice());
038        if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem("map") == null) {
039            pGameEngine.getGui().showMap("no map.jpeg");
040        }
041        return false;
042    } // execute()
043}
